_readme: All resume text lives here. Edit this file and push to GitHub; the live site updates automatically. The page shows each job's 'key' bullets (3 is best) and hides 'creative', 'highlights', and 'earlier_roles' behind a 'More' link. Work items with "featured": true show first; the rest appear under 'See all work'. The 'intro' block sets the welcome pop-up's text, choices, and delay; answers are saved to the visitor_intros table in Supabase. A job's optional 'since' note (for example 'At Fromm since 2005') shows under its dates.
_work_help: Each item in 'work' is one card. Optional: 'image' (or 'images': a list of {"src", "alt"} for a small gallery) (a picture you put in public/work/, e.g. "/work/poster.jpg"), 'imageFit': "contain" or "contain-light" (show a logo or screenshot whole on a dark or white background instead of cropping it), 'video' (a YouTube or Vimeo link; YouTube also gives the card its picture), 'link' (any web page), 'role', 'collaborators', 'details'. category must be one of: Design, Video, Storytelling, Marketing, Events, Collaborations, Technology, AI.
name: Herbert Gracia
role: Brand & Creative Director, now building with AI
tagline: I build brands from concept to market: two apparel brands co-founded, 21 years at the University of San Francisco's Fromm Institute, and now certified by USF in Applied Agentic AI.
about: My strength is connecting brand strategy, creative thinking, and marketing with execution, from concept and product development through campaign, production, digital platforms, sales, and customer experience.

My background spans brand strategy, creative direction, art direction, integrated marketing, visual storytelling, video, product development, manufacturing, sales, technology, AI, and experiential marketing. I also use AI and generative AI in campaign development, content creation, audience messaging, research, social media marketing, and creative workflows.
